headline: Expand difficulty diagnostics to all 1,000 NUTBUSTER stages

changes.title: Audit initial-board difficulty across all ten chapters
changes.detail: Extended the nonblocking board-structure audit from 500 stages to the full 1,000-stage campaign, preserving original authored board seeds, opening-move checks, and existing difficulty-ramp assertions.

changes.title: Exercise complete campaign with the simple gameplay bot
changes.detail: Extended the non-booster greedy-player simulation to two seeded attempts on each of 1,000 stages, recording chapter-level successes and failures without presenting these as human completion rates.

changes.title: Expose per-chapter diagnostic evidence in GitHub Actions
changes.detail: Added a report-only CI summary that verifies ten chapters, 1,000 audited stage layouts, and 2,000 bot attempts before displaying the per-chapter results. This does not gate signed Android releases.
